visual_identity.core_identity: An apparently decorative floor rug animated into a flexible constricting sheet with no face or limbs.
visual_identity.silhouette: Large rectangular textile lifting in a curling wave, corners and edges folding around a target.
visual_identity.head_features: No head, eyes, or mouth; menace comes from folding motion.
visual_identity.body_shape: Flat woven rectangle capable of bending, rolling, and wrapping while keeping identifiable rug edges.
visual_identity.limb_structure: No limbs; corners and sheet edges provide all movement through folds and wraps.
visual_identity.surface: Broad simple geometric or heraldic pattern with large colorable areas, fringe kept sparse.

scene_identity.natural_posture: Part of the rug remains visibly connected to or close to the floor while the sheet curls or wraps.

accuracy_checks: no face or invented limbs appear

known_failure_modes.correction: restore floor-origin constricting fold and wrapping motion

known_failure_modes.symptom: eyes or mouth appear in textile
known_failure_modes.correction: remove face; use sheet motion alone for menace
